_comment: C0-8 正文英译 · brave-search-mcp（2026-10-25）。无 extraSections。

axes.model_access:
**It calls no model itself** — an interface implementation called by MCP clients. It wraps the Brave Search API
(web search, news, images, local places) as tools for agents.
axes.runtime:
A local process (npx stdio) plus a remote-hosted line (the official docs describe a remote endpoint); GitHub 1,544★,
last push 2026-10-27 (API verified).
axes.local_files: Reads and writes no local files — it outputs search-result text/links; fetching page content is out of its scope (that is the fetch server's job).
axes.background: stdio lives and dies with the client; no background-task semantics.
axes.tools:
web_search / news_search / image_search / video_search / local_search etc., grouped by API family,
trimmable via configuration; the complete inventory follows the repo README.
axes.context: No cross-session memory — each search is independent.
axes.permissions:
A Brave Search API key (free/paid tiers follow the Brave API account); a pure read surface —
it cannot write to any system; the risk surface is mainly query egress and quota consumption.
axes.fit:
Fits: giving an agent a "live search" capability (after the archived Brave reference in the MCP repo, the official @brave package took over),
a retrieval source independent of the LLM's built-in search.
Not a fit: deep content fetching (the fetch/firecrawl line); zero-configuration scenarios without an API key.

mcp.transport:
**stdio** (npx @brave/brave-search-mcp-server) is primary; the official docs also describe a remote line — not verified item by item.
Verified against: the repo README (direct-fetched 2026-10-21).
mcp.auth: The BRAVE_API_KEY environment variable; the key's quota/plan tiers follow the Brave API account (prices not collected per our D9 rule).
mcp.scope: Pure read: the search-family tools (web/news/image/video/local). No write surface; no approval needed.

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. The test protocol is at [protocols/mcp/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/mcp/_protocol.md).
unknowns:
- The current status of the remote-hosted line (not verified item by item)
- The full parameter surface of each search-family tool (not enumerated item by item)
related: The search↔fetch division-of-labour contrast: Brave tells you "which page", fetch gives you "this page's body text".
